lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice weighing two sides of an everyday environmental choice.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Choosing between convenience and sustainability when shopping or getting food.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Presenting advantages and disadvantages with a balanced tone.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss whether they should order food delivery or cook with ingredients they already have.

main_focus.name: balanced contrast with å ena sidan and å andra sidan
main_focus.description: Use paired contrast markers to organize two sides of a practical choice.
model_examples: Å ena sidan är det bekvämt att beställa mat.
Å andra sidan har vi redan mat hemma.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use the paired contrast naturally 2-3 times, supported by simpler contrast markers.

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use practical food-choice vocabulary with balanced argument chunks.

dialogue_shape.opening: A small everyday choice is introduced.
dialogue_shape.middle: They name one advantage and one drawback for each option, then weigh what matters most today.
dialogue_shape.ending: They choose a practical option and give a brief reason.

target_complexity.repetition: balanced contrast markers should organize the reasoning clearly

focus: the advantage and drawback that matter most
the reason for the final choice

sentence_focus: one sentence starting with å ena sidan
one sentence starting with å andra sidan
one sentence choosing the most reasonable option
